Recent completed work includes finance foundation, fuel/documents, workspace hardening, notifications, driver assignment workflow, dispatch board, POD billing, workflow feedback, and Swagger/OpenAPI endpoint coverage. Latest main still needs final local/CI verification before full acceptance.
